summary: Closed Set 04 F16 on the DXVK branch by changing the fixed SpriteNode semantic-tag table to preserve all already-published live exact owners at capacity and reject only the newest unique registration, with diagnostic telemetry and executable regression coverage.
selection_reason: All higher-priority direct DXVK queue items were either DONE or genuinely NEED_HMD_TEST. F16 was the highest remaining software-only backend-neutral semantic correctness gap from the 100-review campaign that materially affects DXVK exact HUD/rank ownership and can be completed without hardware evidence.

source_commit.message: Fail closed DXVK semantic tag overflow [AUTO:CONVERSION-DXVK-00053]

behavior_verified: A full semantic-tag table no longer replaces the oldest live published entry.
Updating an existing node while the table is full remains accepted and does not count as overflow.
A new unique registration at capacity is rejected fail-closed and increments SpriteNodeSemanticOverflowRejected without incrementing SpriteNodeSemanticStaleCleared.
The oldest exact ScreenHud owner remains consumable after an overflow attempt.
The rejected newest node falls back to ScreenOverlay2D rather than stealing another queued node's exact owner.
After capacity is freed, the previously rejected producer can register and consume its ProjectedWorldMarker2D owner normally.
No ScreenHud/WorldBillboard/ProjectedWorldMarker2D classifier widening or visual placement math changed.

regression_scope.note: The change is limited to full-table admission behavior and does not broaden semantic ownership. Existing HMD-visible visual regressions remain separate runtime gates.

blocker: No software blocker remains for F16. Existing DXVK visual, DirectGPU transport and performance conclusions still require exact-build Quest3/VDXR evidence.
next_action: Do not reopen F16 unless its static/behavior gate regresses or new runtime evidence identifies a distinct overflow failure. Continue the existing exact-build Quest3/VDXR gates for DXVK visual ownership, host-owned DirectGPU transport and performance; keep those runtime conclusions unproven until matching hardware evidence exists.
